title: Ganita Prakash: Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 8, Part I and Part II — Grade 8 Mathematics (CBSE / NCERT)

source.title: Ganita Prakash: Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 8, Part I and Part II
source.edition: Part I first edition 2025; Part II first edition (2025-26 session, exact date not verified); 2026-27 reprint not verified
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g08.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://ciet.ncert.gov.in/audio-book/130 https://edustud.nic.in/edu/Syllabus_2026_27/8/8_MATH_SYLLABUS_2026_27_EM.pdf https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/Circulars/2025/48_Circular_2025.pdf https://www.cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/Circulars/2025/12_Circular_2025.pdf. Notes: ncert.nic.in (textbook.php and the textbook PDF/prelims files) refused automated fetching (robots.txt disallow) on 2026-10-19, so the NCERT contents pages, printed section headings and edition/reprint lines could not be read directly. Chapter titles were verified instead against other official government sources: NCERT's CIET audio-book pages (ciet.ncert.gov.in) and the Delhi Directorate of Education 2026-27 syllabus (edustud.nic.in), which prescribes NCERT books. 'verified': true means the title was seen in at least one of those sources. CBSE does not publish its own mathematics syllabus for Grades 6-8. Its 2026-27 curriculum release (Circular Acad-14/2026) covers Classes IX-XII only, and CBSE circulars direct schools to the new NCERT textbooks. The 2026-27 prescription is therefore inferred from those circulars plus the Delhi DoE 2026-27 syllabus. No CBSE or NCERT notice found replaces or withdraws Ganita Prakash for 2026-27. Section titles come from the subtopic lists in the Delhi DoE 2026-27 annual syllabus, not from the printed textbook. They appear to quote the textbook's section headings, but DoE may have shortened, merged or left some out (its list is 'for assessment purpose only'), and capitalisation follows DoE. Check them against the printed NCERT book before using them as exact headings.
